documentation: PLC WRITE LOCK (docs/plc-write-lock.md). true = every tag that reads the RCP1 controller (all of [default]_RCP1_ and the OPC members of the PLC / Devices UDT definitions) is read only and HMI writes into the PLC are refused. Set false in the Designer / Tag Browser to unlock for testing, true to relock - the gateway tag-change event plcWriteLock applies it (gateway log: shared.PlcWriteLock). Bad / null and gateway startup = locked. A PLC write also needs the OPC UA server block removed (.cursor/tasks/rcp1-write-block).
name: Locked
